ReplayVerificationError carries requested/completed/canceled counts and wall time. Evaluation aggregates successful and failed attempt receipts; only successful proofs enter replay cache. Canceled deadline and fully computed snapshot-mismatch probes both preserve actual replay costs.

limitations: No patient/acquired anatomy, vascular graph, thermal, continuum, CUSA v3, resident C++ policy or general primitive-RL training admission. Existing primitive adapter remains evaluation-only.
Generated motor/CST membership and removal are stylized constraints, not motor function, paralysis probability, language outcome or clinical validation.
Earlier access costs remain unknown; no whole-procedure success claim.
Finite beam search is approximate and adapted to these post-access skills; this does not qualify all opening/milling controllers or optimal search.

Static source/inventory preparation precedes online selection. Online masks, analytic features, previews, policy/search wall time and requested physical calls are accounted; reset/replay/training are separate.
Canceled atomic requests commit no transition or treatment/reward; their computation is charged and canceledRequests is distinct from completed attempts/refusals.
Admission permits the bounded experiment, not superiority. Frozen results must retain failures/timeouts, compare paired held-out outcomes and preserve negative learning results.
Only checkpoints with actual optimizer updates greater than zero may be described as trained/RL; initial or zero-update checkpoints remain untrained regardless of descriptive flags.
Fresh frozen pilot/protocol and held-out native/adapter replay remain required execution checks; earlier prototype pilots are not current-source qualification.
